sources.title: Data Security Leader Cyera Raises $300 Million at $1.4 Billion Valuation
sources.evidence: Cyera reported a $300 million Series C led by Coatue, with Spark Capital, Georgian, AT&T Ventures, Sequoia, Accel, Redpoint and Cyberstarts participating. It states that Yotam Segev and Tamar Bar-Ilan founded Cyera in 2021. Its platform discovers, classifies and governs enterprise data.

sources.title: Company
sources.evidence: Cato supplies a cloud-native SASE platform connecting enterprise users and applications. The company page identifies Shlomo Kramer and Gur Shatz as co-founders and says Kramer co-founded Cato in 2015.

sources.title: Cato Continues Expansion with New Global Headquarters
sources.evidence: Cato says it opened new corporate/global headquarters in the Sarona neighborhood of Tel Aviv, Israel. This is a dated 2024 observation, not a legal-incorporation assertion.

sources.title: About Oasis
sources.evidence: Oasis develops management, risk assessment and lifecycle governance for non-human identities. The leadership page identifies Danny Brickman as co-founder and CEO and Amit Zimerman as co-founder and CPO.

sources.title: Island Announces $400 Million Series F, Bringing Valuation to $6.4 Billion
sources.evidence: Island announced a $400 million Series F led by Evolution Equity Partners, with Prysm Capital, Sequoia Capital, Coatue Management, Cyberstarts, Insight Partners, J.P. Morgan Growth Equity Partners, Alta Park Capital, Georgian, G Squared, Squarepoint and Dmitri Alperovitch participating. Island describes a control platform for people and AI agents spanning browsers, endpoints, networks and data.

sources.title: Island introduces first Enterprise Browser to improve enterprise security
sources.evidence: Island identifies Dallas as headquarters and Tel Aviv as its research and development location. It identifies Mike Fey and Dan Amiga as co-founders, respectively CEO and CTO. Its launch product was an enterprise browser with corporate security and governance controls. Page body does not supply an exact publication date.

sources.title: The Next Wave Is Here: Upwind’s $400M Series C to Build The Cloud & AI Security Platform
sources.evidence: Upwind announced a $400 million Series C led by Bessemer Venture Partners. It names Greylock Partners, Cyberstarts, Craft, Salesforce Ventures, Alta Park, Picture Capital, Swish Ventures, Cerca Partners, TCV, Penny Jar, Leaders Fund and Canapi Ventures in the financing. The post concerns a cloud and AI security platform.

sources.title: Newsroom
sources.evidence: Upwind’s newsroom states it was founded in October 2022 in San Francisco, California. It identifies Amiram Shachar as co-founder and CEO, describes a cloud-security business founded by the team behind Spot.io, and lists dated announcements. San Francisco is explicitly the founding location here, not an explicit headquarters statement.

sources.title: About Upwind
sources.evidence: Upwind describes cloud and AI security. Its leadership page identifies Amiram Shachar as co-founder and CEO, Tal Zur as co-founder and CTO, and Lavi Ferdman as co-founder responsible for growth. It does not establish that these three are an exhaustive founder list.

sources.title: Pentera Secures $60M to Lead Security Validation Market Consolidation and Drive Next Phase of Growth
sources.evidence: Pentera announced a $60 million Series D led by Evolution Equity Partners with Farallon Capital Management participating. Pentera describes automated validation of security exposures across on-premises networks, internet-facing assets and multi-cloud environments.

sources.title: About Pentera
sources.evidence: The company page says Pentera has operated in exposure validation since 2015. It identifies Dr. Arik Liberzon as founder. The page describes teams across multiple regions, without an explicit headquarters label in the reviewed text.

sources.title: Silverfort Raises $116M to Deliver a Unified Layer of Identity Security Across All Enterprise Resources
sources.evidence: Silverfort announced a $116 million Series D led by Brighton Park Capital. Participating existing investors named are Acrew Capital, Greenfield Partners, Citi Ventures, General Motors Ventures, Maor Investments, Vintage Investment Partners and Singtel Innov8. The release describes enterprise identity protection. Its Tel Aviv and Boston dateline is not treated as a headquarters determination.

sources.title: About Silverfort
sources.evidence: Silverfort states it was founded in 2016. It identifies Hed Kovetz, Yaron Kassner and Matan Fattal as co-founders, with Kovetz CEO and Kassner CTO. It describes security for identities across cloud and on-premises infrastructure.

sources.title: About Torq
sources.evidence: Torq states that Ofer Smadari, Eldad Livni and Leonid Belkind founded the company in 2020. It describes AI-driven security operations automation and lists teams in Israel and other regions.

sources.title: The Agentic SOC is Here: Torq Raises $140M Series D to Dominate the Future of Security Operations
sources.evidence: CEO and co-founder Ofer Smadari’s post is dated January 12, 2026 and says Torq closed a $140 million Series D. It corroborates the press-release dateline and gives a valuation of $1.2 billion; the valuation is not funding amount.

sources.title: Building The Trust Layer for Enterprise AI
sources.evidence: Cyera announced a $600 million Series G led by Evolution Equity Partners. It names Cyberstarts, Temasek, Accel, AT&T Ventures, Blackstone, Coatue and Spark Capital among participating investors. The named set is explicitly non-exhaustive. Its platform covers sensitive-data classification, data loss prevention, identity/access controls and AI governance.

sources.title: Cyera Announces $400 Million Investment from Goldman Sachs to Build the Trust Layer for the Agentic Enterprise
sources.evidence: Cyera announced a $400 million extension to its Series G from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives. The text describes the parent Series G as led by Evolution Equity; it does not establish that Evolution made a new investment in this extension. The extension is distinct from the original $600 million announcement.

sources.title: Cyera Careers
sources.evidence: Cyera’s locations section labels both New York and Tel Aviv as headquarters. This supports a dual-headquarters observation, rather than forcing a single country from a press dateline.

sources.title: Cyera Completes Acquisition of Oasis Security
sources.evidence: Cyera announced completion of its acquisition of Oasis Security on September 3, 2026. The transaction is an acquisition, not a funding round. The source says the Oasis platform will operate as Cyera Identity; the historical company identity remains distinct from the product/business integration.

sources.title: Building The Next-Generation AI Security Platform
sources.evidence: Danny Brickman states that he and Amit founded Oasis in 2022. On July 28, 2026 he reported a letter of intent to be acquired by Cyera and said completion was still in progress. This announcement is earlier than the separate September completion announcement.

sources.title: Cato Networks Raises $359 Million at a Valuation of More Than $4.8 Billion
sources.evidence: Cato announced a $359 million Series G. The announcement names new investors Vitruvian Partners and ION Crossover Partners together with existing investors Lightspeed Venture Partners, Acrew Capital and Adams Street Partners. It reports a valuation greater than $4.8 billion, which is separate from the round amount. Lead wording spans a group of new and existing investors.

sources.title: Our Partnership with Oasis Security: Securing Access for the Agentic Era
sources.evidence: Search returned an article excerpt, but opening the URL redirected to the Craft homepage and did not expose the article. The article is not accepted as claim evidence in this packet.

sources.title: Torq Secures $140M Series D at $1.2B Valuation to Lead the AI SOC and Agentic AI Era
sources.evidence: Torq’s page header says January 9, 2026, while its body dateline says January 12, 2026 and reports a closed $140 million Series D. It names Merlin Ventures as lead, with Evolution Equity Partners, Notable Capital, Bessemer Venture Partners, Insight Partners and Greenfield Partners participating.
sources.date_conflict: Header 2026-01-09; announcement dateline 2026-01-12; CEO blog supports 2026-01-12.

sources.title: Contact Us
sources.evidence: Torq currently labels Tel Aviv as International HQ and Denver as Americas HQ. These regional designations are retained exactly; they do not resolve the company’s ultimate legal parent.

sources.title: Privacy Policy
sources.evidence: The privacy policy identifies Torq Technologies Ltd. as incorporated under Israeli law. This is entity-specific evidence for that named operating/controller company; the packet does not infer the incorporation of every group entity.

sources.title: Pcysys announces $25M Series-B funding round led by Insight Partners
sources.evidence: Pcysys announced a completed $25 million Series B led by Insight Partners with Awz Ventures and The Blackstone Group. It states Pcysys was founded in November 2015 by Arik Liberzon and Arik Faingold. Founding is month-precise, not an incorporation date.

sources.title: Pcysys rebrands as Pentera
sources.evidence: Pentera explicitly identifies Pcysys as its previous name. The June 16, 2021 announcement supports alias reconciliation between the two names.

sources.title: Website Terms and Conditions
sources.evidence: The terms identify Pentera Security Ltd. as incorporated in Israel with its principal place of business in the Petah Tikva area. The page also expressly restricts crawling. Further Pentera research was stopped on encountering that restriction; source/crawler approval requires owner review.

sources.title: Silverfort Expands North American Presence with New Offices in Boston and Houston

sources.title: Island Secures $250 Million as Valuation Continues to Soar to Nearly $5 Billion
sources.evidence: Island announced a $250 million Series E led by Coatue Management with unspecified existing investors participating. It explicitly states a 2020 founding and a February 2022 public launch. These are different dates; the launch is not the founding date.

sources.title: Newsroom
sources.evidence: The newsroom links a Series B story under April 7, 2026. The underlying company-issued Newswire release is dated March 19, 2026. A listing date is not used as the financing announcement date.

sources.title: Oasis Security Raises $120M Series B to Secure the Rise of Enterprise AI Agents
sources.evidence: Oasis announced $120 million in Series B financing led by Craft Ventures, with participation from Cyberstarts, Sequoia Capital and Accel. It describes non-human-identity and agentic access governance. The New York dateline is not treated as a legal or headquarters claim.

sources.title: Contact Silverfort
sources.evidence: Silverfort’s current contact page labels the United States location in Plano, Texas as HQ. It separately lists a Tel Aviv, Israel location. This differs from the older 2018 Tel Aviv-headquarters statement and is retained with temporal scope.

sources.title: Cato Networks Acquires Aim Security to Extend SASE Leadership and Secure Enterprise AI Transformation
sources.evidence: Cato reported an additional $50 million Series G extension from Acrew Capital, taking the full round to $409 million on the same terms. The $409 million total is not a second new funding inflow. The same release concerns Cato’s acquisition of Aim Security.

sources.title: Torq Announces Revenue and Employee Growth
sources.evidence: A 2025 Torq press release describes New York City as worldwide headquarters. The current contact page instead labels Tel Aviv International HQ and Denver Americas HQ. Preserve these differently scoped observations rather than silently erasing one.

sources.title: Oasis Privacy Policy
sources.evidence: Oasis’s privacy policy says Oasis Security Ltd. becomes part of Cyera Ltd. effective September 30, 2026. This is a privacy/legal-entity effective date, distinct from Cyera’s September 3 acquisition-completion announcement. The page does not explicitly establish country of incorporation.

sources.title: Customer Success Engineer at Oasis Security
sources.publisher: Accel job board / Oasis job description
sources.evidence: A company job description hosted by Accel says Oasis’s engineering and product teams are in Tel Aviv and its field team is primarily in the US. The role is closed; the text is historical evidence of operating geography, not a live-job or headquarters claim.
